title.narrative: Health Early Lifesaving Project (HELP) for people likely to be most affected by El Nino induced Flooding in District Bardere, Gedo Somalia

description.narrative:
ltpgt lt/pgt
ltpgtltspangtThe proposed project entails to reach out 22,000 women, men, children (including persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups) in district Bardere, Gedo region with quality health services over a period of 06 months. The project will target the vulnerable IDPs and host communities affected by the recent riverine and flash floods and those at-risk of being affected by the oncoming potential flooding/heavy rains under existing El Nino system.lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangtThe project has been designed based on the needs of the target population and gaps in the health services accessible to them. The project will provide them services through establish 01 each static and mobile outreach health facilities that will provide the following free quality services in a safe and secure manner.lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtOutpatient consultations for common illnesses such as diarrhea, pneumonia, and malaria, as well as routine immunization for children and PLWslt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtThe health workers will be trained on the identification of major illnesses in the areas including respiratory infections, diarrhea, intestinal parasites, skin infections, neonatal causes, malaria, vitamin A deficiency, anemia, iron deficiency, and acute malnutrition. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtThe staff will be trained through IMCI protocol. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtThe teams will be equipped with essential drugs, vaccines, and the necessary medical equipment and supplies. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtEstablishment and support of referral pathways (for GBV, MHPSS services) lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtCapacity of health workers working in two mobile clinics and one semi-permanent OPD static facilities. They will be trained on Integrated Management of Childhood Illnesses (IMCI), lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtExpanded Program on Immunization (EPI), effective disease surveillance and reporting on Early Warning, Alert, and Response Network (EWARN), lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtBasic Emergency Obstetric Newborn Care (BEmONC) trainings, and clinical management of rape (CMR), safe referral, and psychological first aid (PFA). lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtProvide sexual and reproductive health services, including antenatal, skilled birth attendance, and postnatal care services to pregnant and lactating women attending the mobile clinic. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtVaccination 7,125 children and 4,244 women of child-bearing age against vaccine-preventable diseases, with targeted action to reach children with disabilities. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtHealth awareness, social mobilization, education, and advocacy activities will be conducted to create awareness on preventive measureslt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangt-ltspangt lt/spangtThe project will also conduct staff capacity development on mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) to address the needs of vulnerable populations affected by conflict, displacement, and other hardships in targeted districts of Bardere. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspangtThere will be close coordination with MoH, health and local authorities, health cluster and other relevant actors (ACTED and HIRDA for FS, HIRDA for WASH and NoFYL for CP and GBV) for efficient and effective implementation of the project. Robust monitoring and complaint and feedback mechanisms will be in place to ensure QA and adherence to CHS and AAP principals. The project will strengthen the capacity of community health committee and link them with MoH and health authorities for continuing the action beyond the life of the projectlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgt ltspangtThe project will be integrated with WASH projects in Bardera district by other partners under SHF RA 5. It will ensure lesser number of people falling victim to water, sanitation and hygiene related diseases as the projects will be providing WASH services. There will also be integration with protection projects as that integration will help establishing and supporting referral pathways for GBV and MHPSS services. There will also have integration with nutrition projects that will help the target beneficiaries do not suffer from malnutrition and thus do not require health services.lt/spangt
